title: Corner Product Site - Landed in Heaven Visual Spec
summary: Visual design for corner.app (or the Corner product section of aheadofmarket.com). Ultra clean, white, spacious. Apple keynote energy. The calm before the game storm. Bobby builds this.
content:
Corner Product Site: "Landed in Heaven" Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. The product website that sells Corner. This is how the world first sees what we've built.

Design Philosophy

Patrik's directive: "Site = heaven. Ultra clean, white, spacious. Calm container for creative worlds inside."

This is the Apple keynote aesthetic applied to an AI operations product. The site itself is serene, confident, and spacious. Then inside that calm container, you catch glimpses of the warm, game-like Corner world. The contrast is the magic: heaven outside, alive inside.

The feeling: "I just landed somewhere important. Everything is clear. Everything is intentional."

Think:

  • Apple.com product pages (the whitespace, the pacing, the confidence)
  • Linear.app (the polish, the typography, the dark-on-light precision)
  • Vercel.com (the developer elegance, the moving-without-moving)

But with AOM's warmth. Not cold tech. Not clinical minimalism. Warm, confident, human.

Color System

The product site lives in an almost-white world with warm undertones.

Token Value Usage
--heaven-bg #FAFAF8 Primary background. Not pure white. Warm.
--heaven-bg-alt #F5F3EF Alternating section backgrounds
--heaven-bg-deep #EDEAE4 Footer, deeper sections
--heaven-text #1A1A2E Primary text. Dark navy, not black.
--heaven-text-secondary #6B7280 Supporting text, captions
--heaven-text-tertiary #9CA3AF Lightest text, subtle labels
--heaven-accent #E85D26 CTAs, highlights, AOM orange
--heaven-accent-soft rgba(232, 93, 38, 0.08) Soft accent backgrounds
--heaven-border #E5E2DB Borders, dividers. Warm, barely visible.
--heaven-game-bg #0A0F1E Dark navy for Corner preview sections
--heaven-cream #FDF6EC Text on dark backgrounds

Typography

Element Font Weight Size (Desktop) Size (Mobile) Color
H1 (hero) Syne 800 72px 40px --heaven-text
H2 (section) Syne 700 48px 32px --heaven-text
H3 (subsection) Syne 600 32px 24px --heaven-text
Body large Space Grotesk 400 20px 18px --heaven-text
Body Space Grotesk 400 18px 16px --heaven-text
Body small Space Grotesk 400 15px 14px --heaven-text-secondary
Caption Space Grotesk 500 13px 12px --heaven-text-tertiary
Label (uppercase) Space Grotesk 600 13px 12px --heaven-accent
Button Space Grotesk 600 16px 15px White (on orange bg)
Nav link Space Grotesk 500 15px 14px --heaven-text-secondary
Stat number Syne 800 56px 36px --heaven-text

Line Heights

  • H1: 1.05
  • H2: 1.1
  • H3: 1.2
  • Body: 1.6
  • Small: 1.5

Letter Spacing

  • H1: -0.03em (tight, confident)
  • H2: -0.02em
  • H3: -0.01em
  • Body: 0
  • Labels: 0.06em (spaced, readable)

Global Layout Rules

Content Width

  • Max content width: 1200px centered
  • Narrow content width: 680px (for text-heavy sections)
  • Wide content width: 1400px (for full-bleed previews)

Section Spacing

  • Between sections: 160px (desktop), 100px (tablet), 80px (mobile)
  • Between heading and content: 48px (desktop), 32px (mobile)
  • Horizontal padding: 80px (desktop), 40px (tablet), 24px (mobile)

The "Breathing Room" Rule

No section should feel crowded. If in doubt, add more vertical space. The site should feel like 60% whitespace. Content floats in open air.

Navigation

Desktop

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| AOM.        Corner    Pricing    Docs    Log In       [Get Started]     |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Height: 72px
  • Background: --heaven-bg at 85% opacity (glassmorphism with backdrop-blur 16px)
  • Position: Sticky, z-index 50
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid --heaven-border (appears on scroll, not at top)
  • Logo: "AOM." in Syne ExtraBold 20px + orange dot. Links to aheadofmarket.com
  • Nav links: Space Grotesk 500, 15px, --heaven-text-secondary. Hover: --heaven-text
  • "Corner" link: Active state when on the product site (underline or bold)
  • "Get Started" button: Solid orange (#E85D26), white text, 40px height, 12px border-radius, 24px horizontal padding
  • Log In: Text link, no button style

Mobile

  • Hamburger menu: Right side, 3 lines, 24px
  • Mobile nav: Full-screen overlay, --heaven-bg, items centered vertically, Syne 600, 28px each, 32px gap
  • "Get Started" button: Full width at bottom of mobile nav

Scroll Behavior

Nav appears/disappears based on scroll direction:

  • Scrolling down: nav slides up and hides (translateY(-100%), 200ms ease)
  • Scrolling up: nav slides back down (translateY(0), 200ms ease)
  • At top of page: always visible
  • This gives more viewport space while reading

Section 1: Hero

The first thing anyone sees. Serene. Confident. One clear message.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|                                                                          |
|                    YOUR AI TEAM.                                         |
|                    ALL IN ONE ROOM.                                      |
|                                                                          |
|            Your business runs itself while you focus                     |
|            on what actually matters.                                     |
|                                                                          |
|              [Get Started]    Watch Demo >                               |
|                                                                          |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Vertical padding: 200px top, 120px bottom (desktop). 120px top, 80px bottom (mobile).
  • Heading: Syne 800, 72px, --heaven-text, centered. Line break between "YOUR AI TEAM." and "ALL IN ONE ROOM." The period after each line is intentional (adds weight, finality).
  • Sub-heading: Space Grotesk 400, 20px, --heaven-text-secondary, centered. Max width 480px. 24px below heading.
  • CTA row: 32px below sub-heading. Centered.
    • "Get Started" button: 52px height, 200px min-width, solid orange, white text
    • "Watch Demo >" text link: Space Grotesk 500, 16px, --heaven-text-secondary. Arrow animates right on hover (translateX(0) to translateX(4px), 200ms)
  • Background: Pure --heaven-bg. No gradient, no pattern. Just space.

The "Heaven" Reveal (Scroll-Triggered)

As the user scrolls past the hero (50% viewport), a subtle shift happens:

  • A faint warm gradient appears at the very bottom of the hero: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(237, 234, 228, 0.3), transparent). Height: 200px. This hints that something is coming below.
  • No parallax. No moving elements. Just the gradient.

Section 2: Corner Preview (The Window Into the Game)

This is where the calm site reveals the alive world inside.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|   THE COMMAND CENTER                                                     |
|   YOUR BUSINESS DESERVES                                                 |
|                                                                          |
|   +----------------------------------------------------------+          |
|   |                                                            |          |
|   |   [Live Corner Isometric World Preview]                    |          |
|   |   Dark navy background.                                   |          |
|   |   Rooms visible. Agents moving. Speech bubbles.            |          |
|   |   This is a LIVE interactive embed, not a screenshot.      |          |
|   |                                                            |          |
|   +----------------------------------------------------------+          |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Label: "THE COMMAND CENTER" (Space Grotesk 600, 13px, --heaven-accent, uppercase, 0.06em letter-spacing). Centered.
  • Heading: "YOUR BUSINESS DESERVES" (Syne 700, 48px, --heaven-text). Centered. 8px below label.
  • Preview container: 48px below heading.
    • Width: 1200px max (wide content width)
    • Height: 600px (desktop), 400px (tablet), 300px (mobile)
    • Background: --heaven-game-bg (#0A0F1E)
    • Border-radius: 24px (desktop), 16px (mobile)
    • Border: 1px solid rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.08) (very subtle warm border)
    • Box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.25), 0 4px 16px rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.15)
    • Content: A miniature, non-interactive (or lightly interactive) version of the Corner office. Agents idle, occasional speech bubbles pop up with demo text. Auto-panning camera slowly sweeps across rooms. This is an embedded Canvas/SVG component, not a video.
    • Fallback (if embed is too heavy): A carefully composed screenshot with a subtle CSS animation (soft pulsing glow on the office, 4s ease-in-out infinite)

Scroll Animation

The preview container enters with a scroll-triggered reveal:

  • At 30% viewport: opacity 0, translateY(40px)
  • At 60% viewport: opacity 1, translateY(0)
  • Duration: 800ms, ease-out
  • The shadow intensifies as it enters (shadow opacity from 0 to full over the same 800ms)

Section 3: Three Modes

Show that Corner isn't just the isometric view.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|   THREE WAYS TO WORK                                                     |
|   Pick how you see your team.                                           |
|                                                                          |
|   +---------+    +---------+    +---------+                             |
|   |  GAME   |    |  LIST   |    |  RPG    |                             |
|   |         |    |         |    |         |                             |
|   | [iso    |    | [check  |    | [party  |                             |
|   |  view]  |    |  list]  |    |  screen]|                             |
|   +---------+    +---------+    +---------+                             |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Heading: Syne 700, 48px, centered
  • Sub-heading: Space Grotesk 400, 20px, --heaven-text-secondary, centered

Mode Cards

Three cards, equal width, 24px gap between them.

Card spec:

  • Width: 33% - 16px
  • Height: 360px (desktop), auto (mobile, stacked)
  • Border-radius: 20px
  • Background: --heaven-bg-alt
  • Border: 1px solid --heaven-border
  • Padding: 0 (image bleeds to edges) + 32px for text area

Card structure:

  1. Preview image/video (top 60% of card): Screenshot of that mode. Dark navy background inside the preview. Border-radius matches card top.
  2. Mode name (below image): Syne 600, 20px, --heaven-text. 16px below image.
  3. Description (below name): Space Grotesk 400, 15px, --heaven-text-secondary. 8px below name. Max 2 lines.

Mode descriptions:

  • Game: "Your office comes alive. Watch your agents work, hand off tasks, and build your business in real-time."
  • List: "Simple. A checklist per agent. Drag, check, done. No learning curve."
  • RPG: "Full stats. Party screen, quest log, mission feed. For the power users."

Hover behavior: Card lifts 4px (translateY(-4px)), shadow intensifies (0 8px 32px rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.08)), border color shifts to --heaven-accent at 20% opacity. 200ms ease-out.

Mobile

Cards stack vertically. Full width. 16px gap. Height auto.

Section 4: How It Works

Simple 3-step visual.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|   HOW IT WORKS                                                           |
|                                                                          |
|   1. TELL US                 2. WE BUILD               3. YOU RUN       |
|   ABOUT YOUR                 YOUR CORNER                YOUR BUSINESS    |
|   BUSINESS                                                               |
|                                                                          |
|   Answer 6 simple            Your AI team gets          Chat with your   |
|   questions. Takes           custom rooms, roles,       agents. Assign   |
|   5 minutes.                 and context. Ready         tasks. Watch     |
|                              in under 2 minutes.        them work.       |
|                                                                          |
|   [1]------------------[2]------------------[3]                         |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Heading: Syne 700, 48px, centered
  • Step number: Syne 800, 56px, --heaven-accent. Centered above step title.
  • Step title: Syne 600, 24px, --heaven-text. Centered.
  • Step description: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, --heaven-text-secondary, centered, max-width 280px.
  • Connector line: 1px --heaven-border, horizontal, connecting the three step numbers. Position behind the numbers. On mobile: vertical line between steps.

Step Icons (Alternative to Numbers)

Could use simple line illustrations instead of numbers:

  1. Chat bubbles (representing the onboarding conversation)
  2. Building blocks assembling (representing the office being built)
  3. A command center dashboard (representing the daily experience)

Each illustration: 64x64px, line art, --heaven-text stroke, no fill.

Section 5: What Your Team Does

Agent capabilities section. Shows the breadth of what Corner agents handle.

Layout

|   | responded to.       |  | confirmed.         |                        |
|   +--------------------+  +--------------------+                        |
|   +--------------------+  +--------------------+                        |
|   | LEADS               |  | OPERATIONS         |                        |
|   | Captured and        |  | Organized, tracked |                        |
|   | responded to in     |  | nothing slips.     |                        |
|   | under 60 seconds.   |  |                    |                        |
|   +--------------------+  +--------------------+                        |
|   +--------------------+  +--------------------+                        |
|   | STRATEGY            |  | BUILDING           |                        |
|   | Market research,    |  | Websites, tools,   |                        |
|   | competitor analysis |  | automations built.  |                        |
|   +--------------------+  +--------------------+                        |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Heading: Syne 700, 48px, left-aligned (not centered, for variety)
  • Grid: 2 columns, 3 rows. 16px gap.

Capability card spec:

  • Width: 50% - 8px
  • Height: auto (min 120px)
  • Background: --heaven-bg-alt
  • Border: 1px solid --heaven-border
  • Border-radius: 16px
  • Padding: 28px
  • Category label: Space Grotesk 600, 13px, --heaven-accent, uppercase, 0.06em spacing
  • Description: Space Grotesk 400, 17px, --heaven-text, 8px below label. 2-3 lines max.
  • Left accent: 3px left border in a unique color per card:
    • Email: #58A6FF (blue)
    • Calendar: #F59E0B (amber)
    • Leads: #EF4444 (red)
    • Operations: #3FB950 (green)
    • Strategy: #3B82F6 (blue)
    • Building: #9C27B0 (purple)

Mobile

Single column. Full width cards.

Section 6: Social Proof / Stats

Numbers that build trust. Clean, big, confident.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|        <2min              99.2%              24/7                        |
|      Time to first      Uptime             Your agents                  |
|      value                                 never sleep                  |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Background: --heaven-bg-alt (alternating section)
  • Stat numbers: Syne 800, 56px, --heaven-text
  • Stat labels: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, --heaven-text-secondary, 8px below number
  • Three stats, equal width, centered
  • Vertical padding: 120px top and bottom

Scroll-Triggered Counter Animation

When the stats section enters the viewport (30%):

  • Numbers count up from 0 to their value over 1.5s
  • "<2min" counts: 0 -> 2 (with "<" prefix appearing at completion)
  • "99.2%" counts: 0.0 -> 99.2 (one decimal)
  • "24/7" appears as text (no counting, just fade in)
  • Easing: ease-out (fast start, slow finish)

Section 7: Pricing

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Heading: Syne 700, 48px, centered

Pricing Card Spec

  • Width: 50% - 12px, max 480px each
  • Border-radius: 20px
  • Border: 1px solid --heaven-border
  • Padding: 40px

Platform card (recommended):

  • Background: --heaven-bg
  • Top accent: 3px solid --heaven-accent at top
  • "RECOMMENDED" badge: Positioned top-right, inside the card. Orange background, white text, 24px height, 12px border-radius, Space Grotesk 600, 12px.

Self-Hosted card:

  • Background: --heaven-bg-alt
  • No top accent

Both cards:

  • Tier name: Syne 700, 24px, --heaven-text
  • Tier subtitle: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, --heaven-text-secondary, 4px below name
  • Price: Syne 800, 40px, --heaven-text, 24px below subtitle. "/month" in Space Grotesk 400, 18px, --heaven-text-secondary
  • Feature list: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, --heaven-text. 24px below price. Each item has a small checkmark icon (16px, --heaven-accent for Platform, --heaven-text-secondary for Self-Hosted). 12px gap between items.
  • CTA button:
    • Platform: Solid orange, white text ("Get Started")
    • Self-Hosted: Outlined (--heaven-border), --heaven-text text ("Contact Us")
    • Both: 48px height, full width, 12px border-radius

Audit note below cards: Space Grotesk 400, 15px, --heaven-text-secondary, centered. "+ $2,500" in Space Grotesk 600, --heaven-text.

Mobile

Cards stack vertically. Platform card first (it's recommended).

Section 8: CTA / Footer Lead-In

Final push before the footer.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|          READY TO MEET YOUR TEAM?                                       |
|                                                                          |
|          5 minutes to set up. No credit card required.                  |
|                                                                          |
|          [Get Started]                                                   |
|                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Background: --heaven-bg-alt
  • Heading: Syne 700, 40px, --heaven-text, centered
  • Sub-text: Space Grotesk 400, 18px, --heaven-text-secondary, centered, 16px below
  • CTA: Same orange button, centered, 32px below sub-text
  • Vertical padding: 120px top, 80px bottom

Footer

Clean, minimal. Not dense.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|  AOM.           Corner         Company        Legal                     |
|                 Features       About          Privacy                   |
|  Ahead of       Pricing        Contact        Terms                    |
|  Market         Docs           Careers         Security                |
|                 Changelog                                               |
|                                                                          |
|  ---                                                                    |
|  2026 AOM. All rights reserved.              Phoenix, AZ               |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Background: --heaven-bg-deep (#EDEAE4)
  • Vertical padding: 80px top, 40px bottom
  • Logo: "AOM." Syne ExtraBold 20px + orange dot
  • Tagline: "Ahead of Market" Space Grotesk 400, 14px, --heaven-text-secondary, below logo
  • Column headings: Space Grotesk 600, 14px, --heaven-text, uppercase, 0.04em spacing
  • Column links: Space Grotesk 400, 15px, --heaven-text-secondary, 12px gap. Hover: --heaven-text
  • Bottom bar: 1px top border --heaven-border. Copyright left, location right. Space Grotesk 400, 13px, --heaven-text-tertiary.

Animations (Global)

The product site uses minimal, purposeful animation. Every animation has a reason.

Scroll Reveals

  • Trigger: Element enters viewport at 30% from bottom
  • Animation: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(24px) to translateY(0)
  • Duration: 600ms
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)
  • Stagger: When multiple elements in a section, 100ms between each
  • Only plays once. No re-triggering on scroll back up.

Hover Effects

  • Buttons: translateY(-1px), shadow intensifies. 150ms ease-out.
  • Cards: translateY(-4px), shadow grows. 200ms ease-out.
  • Links: Color shift to --heaven-text or --heaven-accent. 150ms.

The Corner Preview (Section 2)

The embedded isometric preview has its own subtle life:

  • Agents breathe (idle animation from sprite spec)
  • Occasional speech bubble pops up (every 8-10 seconds, random agent)
  • Camera slowly auto-pans (0.1px/frame, barely perceptible movement)
  • This is the one section that moves on its own, creating contrast with the still site

Loading

  • Page loads with a brief fade-in (300ms, body opacity 0 to 1)
  • No loading screen. No progress bar. Instant content.
  • Images lazy-load below the fold with a subtle fade-in (200ms)

Responsive Breakpoints

Breakpoint Content Width Section Spacing Heading Scale
1440px+ 1200px 160px 100%
1024px-1439px 960px 120px 90%
768px-1023px 680px 100px 80%
390px-767px 100% - 48px 80px 65%

Mobile-Specific Rules

  • All multi-column layouts stack to single column
  • Pricing cards: Platform first (recommended)
  • Mode cards: swipeable horizontal carousel (optional) or stacked
  • Stats: 3 x 1 stacked, not 3 across
  • Corner preview: 300px height, wider border-radius (16px)
  • Hero heading: 40px max, centered, 2 lines max

Page Performance

  • Target: Lighthouse 95+ on Performance, 100 Accessibility
  • First Contentful Paint: <1s
  • Total page weight: <500KB (excluding Corner preview embed)
  • Fonts: Syne (700, 800) + Space Grotesk (400, 500, 600) = ~120KB. Preload critical weights.
  • Images: WebP, lazy-loaded, responsive srcset
  • Corner preview: Loaded after page is interactive (defer). Shows static image until Canvas/SVG initializes.

OG / Social Share

OG Image (1200x630)

  • Background: --heaven-bg (#FAFAF8)
  • Center: "YOUR AI TEAM." / "ALL IN ONE ROOM." in Syne 800, 48px, --heaven-text
  • Below: "AOM." logo + "Corner" product name
  • Bottom-left: Small isometric room preview (128px, pre-rendered)
  • Bottom-right: "aheadofmarket.com/corner"
  • Style: Clean, spacious, matches the site feel

Meta

<title>Corner by AOM | Your AI Team, All in One Room</title>
<meta name="description" content="AI operations platform that feels like a game. Your agents handle email, calendar, leads, and operations while you focus on what matters. Get started in 5 minutes." />

The product site is the front door to heaven. Someone lands here from a cold email, a LinkedIn post, a referral. They've never seen Corner. They don't know what an AI operations platform is. This site has 8 seconds to make them care. Ultra clean. Ultra confident. One clear message: your AI team lives here. Come meet them.
